notice: All organizations, people and events are invented. These cases were written before measuring either retrieval mode. This is a small author-created diagnostic set, not a representative or externally held-out benchmark.

documents.title: Maple staff handbook
documents.text:
Maple staff handbook

Staff receive twenty-four days of vacation each calendar year. Unused vacation may be carried forward for up to three months. The payroll team processes expense reimbursements on the last business day of each month. Requests for new equipment go to the facilities desk.

documents.title: Bracken device policy
documents.text:
Bracken device policy

The Bracken office provides shared laptops for visiting staff. Employees must not copy customer records onto personal USB drives. Encrypted company-issued drives are permitted after approval from the data steward. The reception desk holds the equipment checkout log.

documents.title: Sable packing study
documents.text:
Sable packing study

The Sable team aimed to reduce damaged parcels by fifteen percent. The trial used redesigned inserts in forty packages. Damage rates were not measured, so the trial does not establish any reduction in breakage. Staff reported that the inserts were easier to assemble.

documents.title: Cedar reading room hours
documents.text:
Cedar reading room hours

Notice issued 2031-02-01. The reading room opens at 09:00 on Saturdays. Saturday access requires a library card. The book-return slot remains open after closing. Staff collect items from the return slot at the beginning of each shift.

documents.title: Cedar reading room hours
documents.text:
Cedar reading room hours

Notice issued 2031-03-01; replaces the February notice. The reading room opens at 11:00 on Saturdays. Saturday access no longer requires a library card. The book-return slot remains open after closing. Staff collect items from the return slot at the beginning of each shift.

documents.title: Kestrel dispatch note
documents.text:
Kestrel dispatch note

Kestrel consignments travel by rail to the inland depot. Allow six working days for arrival after dispatch. Customers receive a tracking number when the wagon leaves the terminal. Weekend storage is included in the handling fee. Collect empty crates from the rear entrance.

documents.title: Juniper power contract
documents.text:
Juniper power contract

Juniper is negotiating the next annual electricity agreement. The renewal price has not been quoted. The current agreement ends on 30 September. Meter inspections occur in the first week of each month. Procurement will circulate the supplier proposal when it arrives.

documents.title: Oriel purchase review
documents.text:
Oriel purchase review

The proposed Oriel scanner would replace two older machines. The committee has not approved the purchase. A decision is postponed until the accessibility assessment is complete. Finance has reserved a provisional budget; that reservation is not authorization to order equipment.

documents.title: Morrow duty roster
documents.text:
Morrow duty roster

Inez Solano is responsible for locking the workshop each evening. Tariq Moss checks the inventory on Mondays. The fire panel is inspected by an external contractor every quarter. Notify the shift coordinator when swapping duties so that the roster can be updated.

documents.title: Willow visitor route
documents.text:
Willow visitor route

The Willow gallery's east entrance is closed for repairs. Step-free access is available through the courtyard entrance. Follow the blue signs from the tram stop to reach the courtyard. Group bookings are checked at the information desk before the tour begins.
